name: gspc-evidence-plugin
description: OpenShift console dynamic plugin: the GSPC evidence panel on a console page. Evidence by GSPC · Council of AI. Measurement, not certification.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run vendor && NODE_ENV=production rspack
scripts.build-dev: npm run clean && npm run vendor && rspack

consolePlugin.name: gspc-evidence-plugin
consolePlugin.description: Signed, re-checkable GSPC evidence about MCP servers, agent cards, models and claims, drawn from councilof.ai. Measurement, not certification.
